title: super kekir
description: super kekir добавляет вещи :пластинка,топор,кирка и тд.
body:
![что мод то добавляет](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27fe33e940295e8723ee272747220c1a022a8e45.jpeg)
The Super Kekir mod is a great addition for players who want to make their game faster and more fun. It adds new tools that are much stronger than the usual diamond ones.

The main items are the Super Kekir Pickaxe and Axe. The pickaxe mines stone and ores almost instantly, so you can gather resources very quickly. The axe cuts down entire trees in just a few seconds, giving you all the wood you need for big builds without the long wait.

The mod also includes a unique music disc. It plays an original song that you can listen to in your base, adding a cool and rare item to your collection.

Overall, Super Kekir is perfect for anyone who wants powerful tools and a special music disc to enjoy while playing.
